name: Glen Berman
metaDescription: Glen Berman studies things called 'Artificial Intelligence' and their relationship to the production of scientific knowledge. In his more applied research, Glen develops and evaluates Responsible AI interventions. Postdoctoral Research Fellow at MetaMelb, University of Melbourne.
focus: I study things called Artificial Intelligence and their relationship to the production of scientific knowledge.
roles: I'm a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at [MetaMelb](https://arts.unimelb.edu.au/school-of-historical-and-philosophical-studies/our-research/metamelb), University of Melbourne. I live in Melbourne (Naarm), Australia.

sections.heading: Things I'm writing about at the moment
items: *The arc of metascience*. I'm working on a genealogy of metascience, as part of a larger ARC Discovery Project led by Fiona Fidler and Kate Williams.
*AI interventions in metascience*. Kate Williams and I are working on an experimental scoping review of proposals for, and critiques of, AI interventions in metascience.
*Industrialising cognition*. I'm working on a paper about the interfaces and infrastructures for materialising reasoning.

sections.heading: Other projects
items: [AI as Infrastructure](https://aiinfra.anu.edu.au/) is a small project James Smithies and I have been working on. We've developed [ATLAS](https://github.com/AI-as-Infrastructure/aiinfra-atlas), an open-source harness for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over archival and cultural collections (described in a paper in *Cambridge Forum on AI: Culture and Society*), and through workshops with practitioners have produced a number of [Responsible AI resources](https://zenodo.org/communities/aiinfra/records).

I used to work in social change organisations. These days, I contribute through my role as Chair of the Board at [GetUp](https://www.getup.org.au/), one of the largest campaign organisations in Australia with over a million members fighting for a fair, flourishing, and just Australia.
